rust_declaration.name: split_at_unchecked

trusted_assumptions: The <[T]>::as_ptr representation contract exposes every in-bounds prefix and suffix region.
Raw-pointer add and core::slice::from_raw_parts preserve the modeled region and sequence view.
axiom_compiler_unchecked_sub_usize states that in-bounds usize unchecked_sub equals ordinary subtraction.
rationale: The Rust 1.96 operations and order are preserved. Raw-memory contracts and one explicit compiler-intrinsic axiom establish both returned views.
